name: InterMT-Bench-Images
description: A multimodal benchmark of image-based machine translation/interpretation tasks that pairs images with multilingual text to evaluate models' ability to use visual context for translation and cross-lingual understanding. It measures how well models incorporate image information to produce accurate target-language text. Tasks emphasize grounded generation rather than purely text-only translation.
reputation: A niche, research-oriented dataset from PKU used for multimodal MT evaluation; recognized within specialized multimodal-translation communities but not broadly adopted as a mainstream benchmark.
